title: Wallet to Twitter & Farcaster Lookup
description: Paste wallet addresses to get the X and Farcaster accounts their owners published, or give a handle to get the wallets attested to it.

lookupMode.title: What are you looking up?
lookupMode.description: Forward: wallets in, social accounts out. Reverse: one handle in, the wallets attested to it out.

walletAddresses.title: Wallet addresses
walletAddresses.description: EVM addresses, one per row. Used when the mode is 'Wallet addresses to social accounts'.

walletText.title: Or paste addresses
walletText.description: Paste a CSV column or a newline-separated list. Anything that looks like an EVM address is picked out, so a whole CSV row works. Merged with the list above.

handle.title: Handle to look up
handle.description: The X handle or Farcaster username, used when the mode is one of the reverse options. A leading @ is fine.

apiKey.title: walletlink.social API key
apiKey.description: Starts with wts_live_. Create one free at https://walletlink.social — the free allowance is 100 matches every 30 days, and wallets that resolve to nothing never count against it.

includeMisses.title: Include wallets that resolved to nothing
includeMisses.description: Keep a row for every address submitted, so the output lines up with your input list. Turn off to keep only the matches.

maxReversePages.title: Reverse lookup: pages to fetch
maxReversePages.description: Each page returns up to 100 wallets and costs one match credit per wallet returned, so one page can spend an entire free allowance. Raise this deliberately.
